qualifier: assembly, remodeling and clearance of chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL plus cholesterol efflux
name: Lipoprotein particle assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
rationale: All members concern the life cycle of plasma lipoproteins (intestinal lipid absorption, particle assembly, remodeling, receptor clearance) and LXR/ABCA1-driven cholesterol efflux, which the sterol-transporter, bile and foam-cell confusables lack.

core: Bacterial peptidoglycan sensing by NOD-like receptors
qualifier: TAK1-driven JNK and p38 stress kinase activation
name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and TAK1-driven JNK/p38 signaling
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2 and ALPK1 sensing of peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide and the downstream TAK1-JNK/p38 stress kinase cascade, whereas confusables are TLR/IRAK/TRIF and NF-kB/IKK signaling.

qualifier: commissural and retinal ganglion cell axons
name: Midline axon guidance of commissural and retinal ganglion axons
rationale: All members concern SLIT-ROBO-type repulsive guidance at the midline choice point, including retinal ganglion cell axon guidance and optic nerve formation, which the ROBO/ephrin/netrin signaling confusables lack.

name: Node of Ranvier assembly by L1-family adhesion molecules
rationale: Neurofascin, NrCAM and L1-ankyrin interactions, paranodal junctions and sodium-channel clustering all build axonal nodes for action potential propagation, unlike the myelination, nectin/DSCAM adhesion and connexin confusables.

qualifier: synapse assembly and presynaptic choline uptake
name: Neuromuscular junction assembly and cholinergic choline uptake
rationale: Members cover NMJ postsynaptic and terminal assembly (AChR clustering, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, agrin proteoglycans) and SLC5A7 choline uptake for acetylcholine synthesis, while confusables center on nicotinic receptors and clostridial toxins.

name: RIPK1-mediated necroptosis and its microbial modulation
rationale: All three members concern RIPK1-dependent regulated necrosis and its manipulation by pathogens, distinct from the caspase-8 apoptosis and pyroptosis confusables.

name: Amygdala development and innate social and locomotor behaviors
rationale: Members are innate behaviors (aggression, mating, parental care, grooming, exploration, swimming) plus amygdala development, without the dopamine, drug-response and neuropeptide signaling of the confusables.

core: Hormonal regulation of triglyceride and fatty acid metabolism
name: Glucagon-PKA and LXR regulation of triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members combine glucagon-PKA/PDE3B/AMPK signaling and LXR-regulated lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis genes acting on triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike the ChREBP-glucose, insulin-secretion and adipogenesis confusables.

name: Carnitine, choline, biotin and ubiquinol metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover synthesis, transport and inherited defects of carnitine, choline (with FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation), biotin and ubiquinol, rather than the thiamin/riboflavin vitamins or amino acid and fatty acid oxidation of the confusables.

qualifier: adipocyte differentiation, thermogenesis and lipid droplet triglyceride turnover
name: Adipocyte development, thermogenesis and lipid droplet triglyceride storage
rationale: Members span white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis together with triglyceride synthesis, lipid droplet dynamics and lipolysis, combining what confusables split into adipogenesis-only, triglyceride-only, insulin or glycerol themes.

name: Cochlear hair cell stereocilia and sound mechanotransduction
rationale: All members concern inner hair cell stereocilia and mechanical detection of sound, unlike the photoreceptor, vestibular and inner ear morphogenesis confusables.

qualifier: aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport and acylglycerol synthesis
name: Glycerol backbone metabolism, aquaglyceroporin transport and acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and polyol/fructose metabolism, aquaporin-mediated glycerol and urea transport, and phosphatidic acid to DAG/TAG synthesis; aquaglyceroporin transport is absent from every confusable.

qualifier: positive regulation in skeletal muscle regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation and fusion in muscle regeneration
rationale: All members positively regulate myoblast differentiation, fusion and satellite cell-driven skeletal muscle regeneration, whereas confusables carry negative regulation, proliferation, commitment and atrophy.

name: Cardiac myocyte action potential plateau and potassium-mediated repolarization
rationale: Members cover action potential phases 1-4, Kir/TWIK/voltage-gated potassium channels and atrial/ventricular repolarization, unlike the contraction/calcium-handling and phase 0/conduction-system confusables.

name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
rationale: Members concern PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion plus WNT5A-ROR2 calcium-pathway signaling, distinct from Hedgehog lipidation, vascular FZD4 and planar cell polarity confusables.

name: Protein lysine and arginine methylation
rationale: All members concern methylation of lysine and arginine residues on proteins (including p53), without the histone/DNA methylation, hydroxylation or acetylation of the confusables.

core: p53 regulation and G2 DNA damage checkpoint
name: p53 phospho-regulation, G2 damage checkpoint and AKT signaling
rationale: Members cover p53 phosphorylation and degradation, radiation-induced G2 checkpoint signaling and AKT phosphorylation of cytosolic targets such as MDM2; the AKT component distinguishes it from the p53 transcription and G2/M cell cycle confusables.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenoprotein synthesis and redox protection
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium conversion and excretion, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough insertion, and selenoprotein-linked ROS detoxification and protein repair, unlike the sulfur, glutathione, NADPH and thyroid confusables.

qualifier: ER translocation, folding/quality control and COPII/COPI traffic
name: ER protein translocation, quality control and ER-Golgi vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting into the ER, ER folding and quality control/ERAD, and COPII export with COPI retrieval, whereas confusables are Golgi, endosomal and vesicle-tethering traffic.

name: Heparan sulfate and heparin chain biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern EXT-driven heparan sulfate/heparin chain synthesis and its exostosis defects, distinct from the chondroitin/dermatan sulfate, linkage-region and O-fucose glycosylation confusables.

qualifier: glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and vesicular loading
name: Glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and vesicular loading
rationale: Members concern SLC transporters that clear and package glutamate, GABA and glycine at synapses (with their inherited defects), unlike the GABA synthesis/degradation and aspartate transport confusables.

qualifier: APC/C phosphorylation-driven activation and Cdc20/Cdh1 targets
name: APC/C activation and Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation in mitosis
rationale: Members cover phosphorylation-driven APC/C activation and Cdc20/Cdh1 degradation of cyclin A, Nek2A and late-mitotic targets controlling mitotic exit, whereas confusables emphasize cyclin B/securin degradation, APC/C inhibition and Emi1.

qualifier: cerebral cortex layering and forebrain axon tracts
name: Neural progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical tract formation
rationale: Members cover neuroblast and radial glia division, radial and tangential neuronal migration, cortical layering and commissural/corticospinal tract formation, unlike the patterning, spinal cord and cerebellar confusables.

qualifier: SUMO processing, E1/E2 conjugation cycle and nuclear substrates
name: SUMO conjugation cycle and SUMOylation of nuclear substrates
rationale: Members cover SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of replication, repair, transcription and nuclear envelope proteins, unlike the chromatin-cofactor, nuclear pore and PML confusables.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members concern NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activity, IL-1 processing and regulation of IL-1, IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike the AIM2/CASP4/5 pyroptosis and IL-18 confusables.
